reviews.text: I recently changed vets (after a really disappointing experience) and shortly after my beloved cat became very poorly. I can’t praise the staff in both Castleknock & Clonsilla branches enough.  Their care feels so personal & genuinely caring towards the animals. None of my appointments or treatment felt rushed. I also love the quiet area for cats to wait, a lovely touch. I am so thankful for their care & success treatment. I would recommend Village Vets to everyone.
Excellent service and professional!

Thank you very much for taking the time to review our page and leave us these 5 stars.

Top class service provided at Castleknock Village Vets. Put our little dog at ease before examining her, vet reassuring with clear explanation of Bella’s health issue. friendly and efficient service. Love of animals evident always. Thanks for looking after Bella 🤗 …

Every visit is always a great. I have always found the team to be friendly and helpful. My little dog Milly was spayed here and I was really impressed with how they cared for her, recently we adopted another dog and brought her in for a check up and the vet was very patient and understanding with all my questions. I feel really comfortable leaving my pets in the care of Village Vets Castleknock.

We've used Village Vets now for several years for our two dogs, one of whom had a very serious medical condition which required monthly care. They are fantastic (obviously any 5 star review would say that) but truthfully from the people on the desk to the vets everyone cares, is kind and friendly. They were amazing when one of our dogs died unexpectedly with a level of care and concern that helped us through an awful time.
We are so happy with our vet♥️ she is so good
The staff in Castleknock Village Vets are warm and friendly and genuinely interested in the pets.

The veterinary and administrative team at the clinic is incredibly warm and welcoming. I’d like to give a special thank you to Emmer, Carmen and Andreas for their professionalism and for always making us feel at ease. They take such wonderful care of our pets, Ozzy and Bartho, that every visit becomes a calm and positive experience. And a big thank you as well to Jomana, whose cheerful and kind reception makes everything feel even better.

Thank you very much for taking the time to review our page and leaving us these 5 stars.

Kind regards
Village Vets Castleknock

The staff at Castleknock were super helpful with fitting us in last minute today after our appointment from another clinic was cancelled last minute. All very welcoming and helpful when we arrived as first time visiting this clinic.

Really upset now. Went for a routine annual vaccine booster for the cat. Guilt tripped into getting the annual pet care plan to schedule a dental check up because "of serious concerns of the risk of death based on the look of her teeth", followed by two months of last minute cancellations from them, excuses for not moving forward unless we put the cat in overnight, with no mention that this would double the cost. Procedure doesn't go ahead until we move to another branch, and they come back to say x ray is fine, bit of a teeth clean but nothing otherwise needed. I'm now 400 euro out of pocket today, with a contract locking me in for another ten months costing 250. All for 'peace of mind' saying nothing of the weeks of stress caused by the original 'urgent need' to remove her teeth. Sick to my stomach with this predatory behaviour.
Always 100% from the team. Bailey is always looked after so well by Clodagh and got a lovely head massage from Elaine today.
